svg.aria-label: GPU thread blocks compute output tiles in parallel Split output $C$ into tiles: simultaneous parallel routes Assemble tiles in place: merge incoming routes before continuing Split output $C$ into tiles — Thread block 1 → Compute $A_1 B_1$ Split output $C$ into tiles — Thread block 2 → Compute $A_1 B_2$ Split output $C$ into tiles — Thread block 3 → Compute $A_2 B_1$ Split output $C$ into tiles — Thread block 4 → Compute $A_2 B_2$ Compute $A_1 B_1$ — $C_{11}$ → Assemble tiles in place Compute $A_1 B_2$ — $C_{12}$ → Assemble tiles in place Compute $A_2 B_1$ — $C_{21}$ → Assemble tiles in place Compute $A_2 B_2$ — $C_{22}$ → Assemble tiles in place Assemble tiles in place → Return $C=AB$ Each thread block multiplies a row block $A_i$ by a column block $B_j$ and writes its own tile $C_{ij}$.
